text:
Sam: hey team, first-day question — I ran the Buildkite pipeline for my starter repo and the CI failed when Buildkite tried to create a GitHub check run: 'POST /repos/.../check-runs 403: installation does not exist' — any ideas? I haven't touched org settings.

morgan: welcome! likely the GitHub App (redwood-ci) isn't installed on that repo/org yet or lost permissions. @Sam can you paste the pipeline link? also run `curl -i -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/app/installations` to see visible installs

Sam: https://buildkite.com/redwood/starter-pipeline/builds/12

ci-bot: Buildkite webhook delivery 2024-03-12T14:22:05Z -> 410 Gone (installation removed)

lee: if the app was recently reconfigured org owners need to re-approve. Ping @org-admins or me and I can request install. Also check org SSO: if org requires SSO, installs must be via SSO-enabled account.

morgan: quick debugging steps:
```
# on your machine
export GH_TOKEN=... # from your personal access token
curl -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" \
  https://api.github.com/app/installations
```
If the app isn't listed, it's an install problem. If it is, check installation repositories: `GET /installation/repositories`

Sam: ran the curl, returns empty list

lee: yep that's it. I'll open a ticket to have infra re-install the GitHub App on the redwood org and give it 'Checks' & 'Pull requests' permission. @infra-oncall can you re-install or point to owner to approve?

infra-oncall: I reinstalled the app on the org and enabled 'Checks' + 'Pull requests' for the repo. Can you re-trigger the Buildkite build, @Sam?

Sam: re-ran -> build 13 succeeded :tada: thanks y'all
